 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Exfoliate | Purify | Smooth

Your nose area needs extra care because it often collects more oil, dirt, blackheads, whiteheads, and clogged-looking pores than the rest of the face. The Nose Scrub is specially designed to gently exfoliate this targeted area and help make the nose look cleaner, smoother, and more refined.

Made with exfoliating Walnut Shell Powder, purifying Charcoal Powder, nourishing Shea Butter, Cocoa Butter, Jojoba Seed Oil, and brightening-care ingredients like Kojic Dipalmitate and Licorice Root Extract, this scrub helps remove dead skin build-up, rough texture, and pore impurities from the nose area.

Its easy stick format makes application simple and mess-free. Just apply on the damp nose area, massage gently in circular motions for 30–60 seconds, and rinse thoroughly with water. With regular use, the nose area feels softer, smoother, and fresher.

Perfect for those who struggle with rough nose texture, oil build-up, blackheads, whiteheads, and dull-looking skin, this scrub is a simple targeted step for a cleaner and polished nose-care routine.

A scrub made not just for exfoliation, but for fresh skin, smoother texture, and cleaner-looking pores.

Note: For external use only. Use 2–3 times a week. Avoid harsh rubbing, broken skin, irritated areas, and contact with eyes. Do a patch test before use. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

 Ingredients
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 • Walnut Shell Powder - Helps physically exfoliate dead skin and rough texture from the nose area.

• Charcoal Powder - Helps purify the look of pores and supports a cleaner skin feel.

• Shea Butter - Helps soften and comfort the skin during exfoliation.

• Cocoa Seed Butter - Supports smoothness and helps keep skin feeling nourished.

• Jojoba Seed Oil - Helps condition the skin and support a soft finish.

• Kojic Dipalmitate - Supports a brighter and more even-looking skin tone.

• Licorice Root Extract - Known for skin-brightening and soothing care.

• Tocopheryl Acetate / Vitamin E - Helps support antioxidant care and skin comfort.

• Bisabolol - Helps soothe and calm the skin.

• Tetra Hydro Ascorbyl Glucoside - A Vitamin C derivative that supports brighter-looking skin.
